/services.name: Root canal treatment
/services.prep_instructions: Eat a light meal beforehand. Plan for numbness for 2–3 hours.

/services.name: Video consultation
/services.prep_instructions: You'll receive a video link 15 minutes before the call.

/services.name: Fasting lipid profile
/services.prep_instructions: Fast for 10–12 hours before the test. Water is fine.

/services.name: Day-care infusion
/services.prep_instructions: Bring a companion and your medication chart.

/services.name: Medication review
/services.prep_instructions: Bring all your current medicines in their packs.

/services.name: CT abdomen with contrast
/services.prep_instructions: Fast for 4 hours. A kidney function test is needed before contrast.

/services.name: MRI brain
/services.prep_instructions: Tell staff about any implants, pacemaker or metal in your body. Arrive 30 minutes early.

/services.name: Ultrasound abdomen
/services.prep_instructions: Fast for 6 hours and arrive with a full bladder.

/services.name: Knee arthroscopy
/services.prep_instructions: Nothing to eat or drink after midnight. Complete pre-op tests 48 hours before.

/services.name: Laparoscopic appendectomy
/services.prep_instructions: Nothing to eat or drink after midnight.
